# Yitbarek Tegene

> AI-native builder. Founder of Eiqora Technologies. Known as Barack; GitHub handle barack-hash. Builds multi-tenant SaaS platforms for institutions (mosques, schools, employment and travel agencies) with tenant isolation enforced by Postgres row-level security, ships in Amharic and right-to-left Arabic, and builds offline edge-AI hardware on Raspberry Pi and Arduino.

> How he works: hand-written coding fluency is Python basics. Every project was built by directing AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor) through specifications, phase plans and reviews. He specializes in identifying and fixing defects in AI-generated applications and content until they are production-ready, verified with measured benchmarks, build logs and regression tests.

Contact: https://github.com/barack-hash · abegazyitbarek@gmail.com
Structured data: https://barack-hash.github.io/projects.json

## Founder
- Eiqora Technologies (https://eiqora.com): per-client software platforms for community institutions. Next.js 16, Supabase, schema-per-client. ~204 routes, 93 migrations.
- BIC Masjid Platform (https://bic.eiqora.com): live masjid platform under Eiqora. Member app, madrasa LMS, imam console. 91 routes.

## Production platforms (own projects)
- Darul Amal (https://www.darul-amal.com): four-portal foreign-employment agency platform, 4 locales incl. Arabic RTL, WhatsApp Business API, Claude translation, Playwright. Private repo.
- Nejashi / Sakina (https://nejashi.vercel.app): multi-tenant mosque SaaS for Ethiopia, pnpm/Turborepo monorepo, Neon RLS, Amharic-first, Ethiopian calendar. Private repo.
- Dar Al Safar (https://www.darulsafar.com, https://github.com/barack-hash/darul-safar-web): travel and concierge agency site and ops portal: CRM, GDS-style ticketing, visa Kanban, ledger, payroll.
- Multitenant Platform (https://github.com/barack-hash/multitenant-platform): RLS-in-Postgres multi-tenant foundation, 13 foundation groups, 173/173 checks, hash-chained audit, pure-Node WebAuthn/TOTP, Next.js operator console.

## Hardware and edge AI
- Offline Survival LLM (https://github.com/barack-hash/offline-survival-llm): Raspberry Pi 5 8 GB, llama.cpp + Qwen2.5-3B, FAISS + BM25 hybrid RAG over 15 public-domain manuals (6,136 chunks), Arduino UNO keypad + LCD1602 input. Measured 4.7 tok/s generation, 69–70 °C under load, retrieval hit@4 34/34.
- Pip desktop agent (https://github.com/barack-hash/desktop-agent): Electron macOS desktop pet driven by headless Claude Code with permission cards and scheduled chores.

## Tools
- Quran Hifz Trainer (https://quran-hifz-trainer.vercel.app, https://github.com/barack-hash/quran-hifz-trainer): offline PWA, custom sabaq/sabqi/manzil spaced-repetition engine, Madinah Mushaf rendering, 255 tests.
- Sovereign Architect: deterministic life planner with CPM scheduling, five-capital simulation, Pareto and Monte Carlo. 104 tests. Private repo.
- Telegram Channel Scraper (https://github.com/barack-hash/telegram-channel-scraper): Telethon + Flask, incremental JSON/CSV archive. MIT.
- Eman: personal project command center, Next.js 16 + Drizzle/Neon + Clerk, AES-256 secure notes. Private repo.

AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor), specification writing, AI code review and slop-fixing, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, C++ (Arduino), React 19, Next.js 15/16, Node.js, Fastify, Electron, Vite, PostgreSQL, Row-Level Security, Supabase, Neon, Drizzle ORM, Stripe, Inngest, WhatsApp Business API, Cloudflare R2, Tailwind CSS v4, Playwright, Vitest, llama.cpp, FAISS, retrieval-augmented generation, Anthropic Claude API, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, Linux, internationalization, Arabic RTL, Amharic, multi-tenant architecture, Vercel.
